answer: The tundra schedule is applied in crystal and forge shows each instalment. A payout is split which means 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3404 identities would post 2928 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
